$comment: Per-component Figma-generation config (see altitude-figma-generate skill). Molecules batch, 2026-08-26. anatomyCase: label shown. sheet.cellWidth: this component's natural width exceeds the library's default 200px sheet pitch (sheet-style.mjs SHEET_CELL_WIDTH_PX), so its instances bled across the border-collapse grid lines and clipped their own helper text. Measured live 2026-08-27 from the widest instance in its own prop sheet, rounded up with breathing room. This is the documented per-component override the generator expects - do NOT re-measure instances inside the build (the sheet-style.mjs header explains why: ~30s per-call ceiling). | v2 (spec 2026-08-30): enumProp pins `labelPosition` as the set's enum VARIANT axis. It cannot be auto-detected here — pickVariantProp's fallback takes the SOLE VARIANT-kind prop, and this contract declares four (isDisabled/isError/isFocused all pair to the State axis, plus labelPosition), so the auto-pick correctly declines and the inset variant would never be generated. This is exactly the case component-config.mjs documents enumProp for. | v2: anatomyCase re-pinned — adding the Label Position dimension changed every case id, and the alphabetical auto-pick landed on `Label=hidden,Label Position=inset`, i.e. the hidden-label INSET form. Anatomy is the structural reference the whole set is built from, so it must be sampled at the DEFAULT shape: label shown, label on top.
